title: The backup page's privacy promises are never checked by any test
what: The page promises 'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.' and that the phone number and gym membership are never in the backup file. No test shows that line, none checks progress photos stay out of the account copy, and none looks inside a saved file for the phone number. Only the gym link being left out is checked.
expected: A test reads the privacy line on the page, saves an account copy and a backup file from a phone with photos and a phone number, and proves neither holds the photos (account) or the phone number and gym membership (file).
fix_line: Add one test that saves both copies and searches them for photos, the phone number and the gym link

title: Ask an AI is never tested empty, after a change, or with a double tap
what: The one phone test opens Ask an AI on a phone with workouts and shares once. No test shows the page for a member with no workouts in 4 weeks (its words and whether the share button hides), none changes the units or logs a workout and checks the text updates, and none taps share twice.
expected: Phone tests open the page with no recent workouts, change kg to lb with the page open, and double-tap share, reading what shows each time.
fix_line: Add the empty, unit-change and double-tap cases to the Ask an AI phone test

title: Asking a trainer for help is never tested on the phone
what: Only the server's once-a-day rule is tested. No phone test taps the trainer help button, sees 'Sent. Your trainer will get in touch.', taps it twice, or sees 'Could not send. Check your internet and try again.' with the internet off. The trainer's first name on the page is never seen either.
expected: A phone test on the gym chain taps the button once, twice and offline, and reads each line.
fix_line: Add the help button taps to the gym-sees phone test

title: The import's privacy line, left-out rows and result counts are never checked
what: Phone tests drive a Hevy import to '<n> workouts imported', but none reads 'Your file is read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.', the 'Rows left out' line for a file with bad rows, the 'Workouts added', 'Sets logged' and 'New exercises created' counts, the 'workouts replaced' and 'Undoing...' lines, or 'Demo removed, history imported'.
expected: The import phone tests read each of these lines, and one uses a file with rows that must be left out.
fix_line: Add these line checks to the existing import flows, plus one file with bad rows

title: The Settings page is checked as data, never on screen, and never after coming back to the app
what: The six groups, their row titles and row lines are tested only as lists in code. No phone test reads the groups on screen, the 'What my gym can see' row in the gym group, the 'Join your gym' line, or what happens after a double tap on a row. No test leaves the app with Settings open and checks the Widgets line or the gym rows update on return.
expected: A phone test reads the Settings groups and rows on screen with and without a gym, and one leaves the app, adds a widget or joins a gym, and comes back.
fix_line: Add one phone flow that reads the Settings page and one that returns to it
